_README: Copy to dart_defines.json (gitignored) on EVERY machine that builds a release, including the Mac you archive from. Build with: flutter build ipa --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines.json. A missing key does not fail the build - it silently changes behaviour, which is how GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID went absent and got the app rejected (App Review 7d5244b9).
_GOOGLE_SERVER_CLIENT_ID: Google OAuth WEB client id. Passed as serverClientId so the ID token carries the audience Supabase's Google provider expects. Required on every platform.
_GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID: Google OAuth iOS client id. REQUIRED on iOS/macOS: the Google SDK has no other source for it here (Info.plist has no GIDClientID and GoogleService-Info.plist is FCM-only with no CLIENT_ID). Without it the sign-in sheet cannot present, never calls back, and the sign-in screen wedges. Its reversed form must also be a CFBundleURLSchemes entry in ios/Runner/Info.plist.
